back: The branch of computer science dealing with the design, construction and operation of robots.
1 Mechanical structure / framework. 2 Electrical components: sensors, microprocessor, actuators. 3 Programmable.
An unmanned aircraft controlled remotely or by its own program using sensors and GPS.
The tool at the end of a robot arm that does the work: gripper, welding torch, spray gun, drill.
Industry, transport, agriculture, medicine, domestic settings, entertainment (and hazardous places such as mines and bomb disposal).
Work in dangerous conditions, 24/7 operation, consistent and accurate, no boredom or tiredness, lower long-term costs.
High initial and maintenance costs, job losses, only do what they are programmed for, faults stop work, need skilled staff.
Independent (autonomous) robots decide from sensor data; dependent robots are controlled or guided by a person (e.g. surgical robots).

front: Is a washing machine a robot?
back: Usually no: it is an automated appliance with an embedded system, fixed programmes and no moving manipulator.
